snippet.description:
AIR 207 Sugandha Gupta’s advice for UPSC Prelims aspirants: Don’t take CSAT for granted!

UPSC Prelims has two papers: General Studies Paper I and CSAT. While GS Paper I determines your Prelims merit score, CSAT is equally important because you must qualify it to clear the examination.

In this Short, Sugandha Gupta, AIR 207 in UPSC CSE 2025, highlights why aspirants should take CSAT preparation seriously and avoid the mistake of neglecting it while focusing only on General Studies.

If you're preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 or 2028, make CSAT a part of your preparation strategy. Build your concepts, practise regularly, and don't wait until the last moment to prepare.

#UPSC #CSAT #UPSCPrelims #UPSC2027 #UPSCPreparation #SugandhaGupta #LevelUpIAS #Shorts
